get.summary: List organization-owned agents for administration (Protected / Org Admin)
get.description: Lists agents owned and configured at the organization level with pagination and filtering. Requires Organization Admin or Owner permissions for the specified organizationId. Use this for administrative dashboards, agent designer consoles, and marketplace configuration. For discovering agents a user can chat with or invoke, use 'agent.listAccessible'.

get.summary: List site-owned agents for core administration (Protected / Site Admin)
get.description: Lists agents owned and configured specifically for a single core/site with pagination and search. Requires Site Admin or Owner permissions for the specified siteId. Use this for core management panels and site agent settings. For user chat and runtime agent selection, use 'agent.listAccessible'.

get.summary: List all accessible agents for user invocation and chat (Protected / User)
get.description: Returns all agents the current authenticated user has permission to interact with, chat with, or invoke across their personal workspaces, organization memberships, site memberships, and installed delegation tiers. Use this for chat assistants, agent pickers, and runtime execution. For administrative management of organization-owned agents, use 'agent.listByOrganization'. For site-owned agents, use 'agent.listBySite'.

post.description: Creates a new post and initializes draft v0.1.0. Content can be supplied in AiBL Markdown, standard Markdown, or ProseMirror JSON. Slugs must follow regex /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/ (lowercase alphanumeric with single hyphens); if omitted, it is automatically derived from the title using slugify. If submitForReview is true, the initial draft is submitted immediately for review/publication.

siteId.description: The ID of the Core (site) where the post will be created

slug.description: URL-safe slug matching /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/. If omitted, automatically derived from title.

content.description: Post content in AiBL Markdown, standard Markdown, or ProseMirror JSON.

submitForReview.description: If true, automatically submits the initial draft v0.1.0 for review/publishing upon creation.

get.summary: Get full post details, drafts, and editorial metadata by slug or ID (Protected / Authoring)
get.description: Retrieves comprehensive post details including active drafts, versions, categories, tags, assets, and editorial workflow metadata by orgSlugOrId, coreSlugOrId, and postSlugOrId. Requires user authentication and author/editor/admin permissions on the site. Use this for CMS, editor workspaces, review workflows, and admin dashboards. For public/anonymous reader viewing by URL slugs, use 'post.getReaderData'.

get.summary: Get published post content for public reader view (Public / Unauthenticated)
get.description: Retrieves published post content, article body markdown/JSON, cover image, attachments, and site/author metadata by public URL identifiers (orgSlugOrId, coreSlugOrId, postSlugOrId). Accessible anonymously without user authentication. Returns only published articles. For internal editor data, drafts, or admin management, use 'post.get'.

get.summary: List posts in a site with pagination, draft filtering, and sorting (Protected / Authoring)
get.description: Lists posts in a core/site with offset pagination, search query, category/tag filters, visibility, and status filters ('ALL', 'PUBLISHED', 'DRAFT'). Requires user authentication and author/admin permissions to view non-published drafts. Use this for CMS tables, author dashboards, and chat workspaces. For public reader feeds, use 'post.listReaderPosts'.
